---

_**Agent (default)**_

### `python test.py --render` 用的是哪个 XML？

取决于你跑的 `--mode`：

- **`--mode actor` 或 `--mode base`**  
  用的是固定文件：`assets2/demo_fourCable_withSteel_withSensor_cylinder.xml`  
  代码位置：`mujoco_env.py` 里 `CableRobotEnv.__init__`（`xml_path = .../assets2/demo_fourCable_withSteel_withSensor_cylinder.xml`）。

- **`--mode actor_obstacles / obstacles / obstacles_base`（你 `test.py` 默认就是 `actor_obstacles`）**  
  逻辑上是“基于 `assets2/demo_fourCable_withSteel_withSensor_cylinder.xml` 作为 base，然后**每个 episode 动态插入障碍物**生成 XML 再加载”。  
  所以**是会有临时 XML**的：`mujoco_env.py` 里用到了 `tempfile`，并且有 `_build_xml_with_obstacles(...)` 这种“拼 XML 字符串”的函数。

### 怎么确认你这次实际走了哪条？
看你命令行有没有显式传 `--mode`。不传的话，`test.py` 默认是：

- `--mode actor_obstacles`

也就是**带障碍物 + 临时 XML**那条路径。

        "contents": "3. **Agent**：以 ε 概率用基座动作、否则用网络动作（且可被 Q 比较否决）；转移存入 buffer；每步训练 2 次（Critic TD + Actor BC+Q），并衰减 ε。\n4. **评估与保存**：每 30 个 episode 评估 100 次，保存最佳 Actor 为 &#96;actor_best.pt&#96;；训练结束后用最佳模型再评估 1000 次得到论文表格用成功率。\n\n---\n\n## 五、依赖与运行\n\n### 5.1 依赖\n\n- Python 3.x（建议 3.8+）\n- PyTorch（含 CUDA 可选）\n- MuJoCo（&#96;mujoco&#96;）\n- CasADi（&#96;casadi&#96;）\n- NumPy、pandas、matplotlib\n- rich（进度条，&#96;learn.py&#96;）\n- 原论文环境还用到 PyBullet（仅当使用 &#96;kuka.py&#96; 时）\n\n### 5.2 常用命令\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 训练（默认 seed=1，日志在 saves/nmpc_experiment/seed_1/）\npython learn.py --seed 1\n\n# 测试训练好的 Actor（100 个 episode）\npython test.py --mode actor --dir saves/nmpc_experiment/seed_1 --episodes 100\n\n# 仅测试 NMPC 基座\npython test.py --mode base --episodes 100\n\n# 测试 NMPC + 障碍物避碰（带渲染）\npython test.py --mode obstacles --episodes 10 --obstacles 3 --render\n\n# 障碍物模式并导出规划路径 CSV\npython test.py --mode obstacles --save_paths_dir saves/paths --episodes 5\n\n# 绘制训练曲线（多 seed 时会在同一目录下找 seed_*/log.csv）\npython plot.py --dir saves/nmpc_experiment\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 5.3 &#96;test.py&#96; 完整命令行参数与示例\n\n&#96;test.py&#96; 支持三种模式，参数如下（未给出的选项使用默认值）。\n\n| 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | 适用模式 | 说明 |\n|------|------|--------|----------|------|\n| &#96;--mode&#96; | str | &#96;actor&#96; | 全部 | 策略：&#96;actor&#96; / &#96;base&#96; / &#96;obstacles&#96; |\n| &#96;--render&#96; | flag | 关闭 | 全部 | 开启动画 |\n| &#96;--episodes&#96; | int | 10 | 全部 | 测试 episode 数 |\n| &#96;--dir&#96; | str | &#96;saves/nmpc_experiment&#96; | actor | 含 &#96;actor.pt&#96; 的目录 |\n| &#96;--obstacles&#96; | int | 3 | obstacles | 每局障碍物数量 |\n| &#96;--seed&#96; | int | 42 | obstacles | 障碍物随机种子 |\n| &#96;--save_paths_dir&#96; | str | None | obstacles | 规划路径 CSV 输出目录 |",
        "detailedLines": [

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "5. **主循环**：\n   - 每 episode：&#96;env.reset()&#96;，记录 &#96;env_target_pos&#96;；循环内 &#96;agent.act(state)&#96; 得到动作（可能来自基座或网络），加小高斯噪声后裁剪，&#96;env.step(action_exec)&#96;，&#96;agent.remember(...)&#96;，&#96;agent.train(2)&#96;；直到 done 或步数达到 150。\n   - 每 30 个 episode 做一次评估（100 个 test episode），若当前成功率超过历史最佳则保存 &#96;actor_best.pt&#96;。\n   - 每 10 个 episode 打印当前 episode 回报、基座使用比例、epsilon。\n6. **结束**：若存在 &#96;actor_best.pt&#96;，加载最佳 Actor 再跑 1000 个 test episode，输出最终成功率。\n\n运行方式：&#96;python learn.py --seed 1&#96;，日志与模型保存在 &#96;saves/nmpc_experiment/seed_1/&#96;。\n\n---\n\n### 3.6 &#96;plot.py&#96; — 训练曲线绘制\n\n- **数据**：从 &#96;root_dir&#96; 下所有 &#96;seed_*/log.csv&#96; 读取，提取 &#96;frames, train_success, test_success_rate, ratio&#96;。\n- **处理**：按 &#96;frames&#96; 对齐到公共 X 轴（插值）；对 train_success、ratio 做滑动平均（窗口可配置）；test_success_rate 不平滑（已是评估均值）。\n- **绘图**：三个子图 — 训练成功率、测试成功率、Base 使用比例；若为成功率图可画一条 Base Controller 基线（如 52.7%）；输出均值 ± 标准差。\n- **保存**：&#96;root_dir/paper_result.png&#96;，dpi=300。\n\n使用：&#96;python plot.py --dir saves/nmpc_experiment&#96;。\n\n---\n\n### 3.7 &#96;test.py&#96; — 测试脚本\n\n- **模式**：&#96;--mode actor&#96;、&#96;--mode base&#96; 或 &#96;--mode obstacles&#96;。  \n  - **actor**：加载指定目录下的 &#96;actor_best.pt&#96;（若无则 &#96;actor.pt&#96;），用 &#96;FastActor&#96; 前向得到动作，每步 &#96;env.step(action)&#96;。  ",

        "contents": "def train(log_dir):\n\n            print(f\"Ep: {episode:4d} | {status_mark} | R: {episode_reward:7.2f} (avg20: {avg_reward:7.2f}) \"\n                  f\"| Steps: {step_count:3d} | Ratio: {ratio:.2f} | Eps: {agent.epsilon:.4f}\")\n\n            with open(log_file, \"a+\", newline='') as csvfile:\n                writer = csv.writer(csvfile)\n                writer.writerow([episode, frames_total, episode_reward,\n                                 loss_c, loss_a, loss_bc, ratio, agent.epsilon])\n\n            if episode \u003e 0 and episode % 50 == 0:\n                torch.save(agent.actor,  os.path.join(log_dir, f'actor_ep{episode}.pt'))\n                torch.save(agent.actor,  os.path.join(log_dir, 'actor.pt'))\n                torch.save(agent.critic, os.path.join(log_dir, 'critic.pt'))\n\n    logger.close()\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    log_dir = 'saves/nmpc_experiment'",

        "contents": "def run_test(mode, log_dir, n_episodes, render, device_id=0):\n    \"\"\"\n    统一的测试主循环 (针对基础 2D 环境，无障碍物)\n    \"\"\"\n    # 1. 初始化环境\n    env = CableRobotEnv(render=render)\n    \n    # 2. 初始化策略 (Actor 或 Base)\n    actor_model = None\n    nmpc_controller = None\n    \n    if mode == 'actor':\n        print(f\"Loading Actor model from {log_dir}/actor.pt ...\")\n        device = get_device(device_id)\n        model_path = os.path.join(log_dir, 'actor.pt')\n        if not os.path.exists(model_path):\n            print(f\"Error: Model not found at {model_path}\")\n            return\n        try:\n            # weights_only=False 解决 PyTorch 2.6+ 兼容性\n            actor_model = torch.load(model_path, map_location=device, weights_only=False)\n            actor_model.eval()\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error loading model: {e}\")\n            return\n    elif mode == 'base':\n        print(\"Initializing NMPC Controller (Base)...\")\n        nmpc_controller = NMPCController()\n    \n    # 3. 开始测试循环\n    success_count = 0\n    total_steps_success = 0\n    \n    print(\"*******************************************\")\n    print(f\"Start Testing [{mode.upper()}] for {n_episodes} episodes...\")\n    print(f\"Render: {'ON' if render else 'OFF'}\")\n    print(\"*******************************************\")\n    \n    start_time = time.time()\n    \n    for i in range(n_episodes):",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Learning of Long-Horizon Sparse-Reward Robotic Manipulator Tasks with Base Controllers\n-----------------------\nThis is the official implementation of our TNNLS paper:\n\n\"Learning of Long-Horizon Sparse-Reward Robotic Manipulator Tasks with Base Controllers\"\n\nGuangming Wang, Minjian Xin, Wenhua Wu, Zhe Liu, and Hesheng Wang\n\n![DDPGwb](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62023129/199145782-19b0d1ab-448e-4598-a185-6187b115ef0d.png)\n\n\n## Prerequisites\n------------------------------\ndocker: https://hub.docker.com/layers/wenhua231/vsdrl/latest/images/sha256-d09a2e0e1f53417b6206a4a4142b37cbdbd769f59ed6ef462fae6f077f40e3ad?context=repo\n- Python 3.6.9\n- PyTorch 1.10.1\n- CUDA 10.2\n- pybullet\n\n## Usage\n----------------------\n### Train\nTrain the complete algorithm with state-input. &#96;-t&#96; is the training task. &#96;-l&#96; is the saving log.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\npython learn.py -q -b -c -t 1 -l 1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nTrain the complete algorithm with image-input.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\npython learn.py -q -b -c -i\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nTrain with ensemble Base Controllers.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\npython learn.py -q -b -c -e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### test\nTest the model in log &#96;-l&#96; of task &#96;-t&#96;.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\npython test.py -t 1 -l 1 \n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### plot\nplot the learning curve for a set of training.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\npython plot.py\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## Citation\n--------------------------------\nIf you find our work useful in your research, please cite:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n@article{wang2022learning,\n  title={Learning of Long-Horizon Sparse-Reward Robotic Manipulator Tasks With Base Controllers},\n  author={Wang, Guangming and Xin, Minjian and Wu, Wenhua and Liu, Zhe and Wang, Hesheng},\n  journal={IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems},\n  year={2022},\n  publisher={IEEE}\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "### 3.7 &#96;test.py&#96; — 测试脚本\n\n- **模式**：&#96;--mode actor&#96;、&#96;--mode base&#96; 或 &#96;--mode obstacles&#96;。  \n  - **actor**：加载指定目录下的 &#96;actor_best.pt&#96;（若无则 &#96;actor.pt&#96;），用 &#96;FastActor&#96; 前向得到动作，每步 &#96;env.step(action)&#96;。  \n  - **base**：不加载网络，仅用 &#96;NMPCController().get_action(obs[:8], target_pos)&#96; 作为动作。  \n  - **obstacles**：使用 &#96;CableRobotEnvWithObstacles&#96; 与 &#96;NMPCControllerObstacles&#96;，路径上随机生成障碍物，NMPC 带避障约束；可统计成功率与碰撞次数，并可选择将每局 2D 规划路径导出为 CSV。\n- **环境**：actor/base 使用 &#96;CableRobotEnv&#96;；obstacles 使用 &#96;CableRobotEnvWithObstacles&#96;（同文件内），参数含延迟与扰动。\n- **障碍物模式专用参数**：&#96;--obstacles&#96;（每局障碍物数量）、&#96;--seed&#96;（障碍物随机种子）、&#96;--save_paths_dir&#96;（导出规划路径 CSV 的目录）、&#96;--payload_radius&#96;、&#96;--planning_margin&#96;、&#96;--planning_grid_res&#96;。\n- **统计**：运行 &#96;n_episodes&#96;（默认 10），统计成功次数、平均成功时步数、总耗时；obstacles 模式额外统计碰撞次数。\n\n使用示例：  \n- 测试 Actor：&#96;python test.py --mode actor --dir saves/nmpc_experiment/seed_1 --episodes 100&#96;  \n- 测试纯 NMPC：&#96;python test.py --mode base --episodes 100&#96;  \n- 测试 NMPC+障碍物：&#96;python test.py --mode obstacles --episodes 10 --obstacles 3 --render&#96;  \n- 导出规划路径：&#96;python test.py --mode obstacles --save_paths_dir saves/paths --episodes 5&#96;  \n- 可视化：任意模式加 &#96;--render&#96;。\n\n---\n\n## 四、数据流与训练流程概览\n\n1. **环境**：&#96;CableRobotEnv&#96; 提供 10 维状态、2 维动作（或内部补全为 3 维）、稀疏奖励与 success 信号；reset 时随机化目标、负载与 mocap 状态；step 时带延迟与外力。\n2. **基座**：NMPC 根据当前 8 维状态与目标位置输出 2 维加速度，经 &#96;nmpc_wrapper&#96; 传给 Agent。\n3. **Agent**：以 ε 概率用基座动作、否则用网络动作（且可被 Q 比较否决）；转移存入 buffer；每步训练 2 次（Critic TD + Actor BC+Q），并衰减 ε。\n4. **评估与保存**：每 30 个 episode 评估 100 次，保存最佳 Actor 为 &#96;actor_best.pt&#96;；训练结束后用最佳模型再评估 1000 次得到论文表格用成功率。",
        "detailedLines": [
          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import numpy as np\nimport torch\nimport csv\nimport os\nfrom rich.progress import Progress, BarColumn, TimeElapsedColumn, TimeRemainingColumn\n\nfrom agent import WBAgent\nfrom mujoco_env import CableRobotEnvWithObstacles\nfrom nmpc_controller import NMPCTrajectoryTracker\n\nnmpc_instance = None\n\n# ===========================================================================\n# 轻量日志封装：优先 wandb，其次 TensorBoard，两者都没有则仅输出到 CSV。\n# 使用方式：在 train() 开头调用 Logger(...)，之后只用 logger.log(step, dict)。\n# ===========================================================================\nclass Logger:\n    def __init__(self, log_dir, project=\"cable_robot\", run_name=None,\n                 use_wandb=True, use_tb=True):\n        self._wandb  = None\n        self._writer = None\n        self.log_dir = log_dir\n\n        # ---- 尝试初始化 wandb ----\n        if use_wandb:\n            try:\n                import wandb\n                self._wandb = wandb\n                self._wandb.init(\n                    project=project,\n                    name=run_name or os.path.basename(log_dir),\n                    dir=log_dir,\n                    config={},\n                    resume=\"allow\",\n                )\n                print(\"[Logger] wandb 初始化成功。\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"[Logger] wandb 不可用，跳过：{e}\")\n                self._wandb = None\n\n        # ---- 尝试初始化 TensorBoard ----\n        if use_tb:\n            try:\n                from torch.utils.tensorboard import SummaryWriter\n                tb_dir = os.path.join(log_dir, \"tb\")\n                self._writer = SummaryWriter(log_dir=tb_dir)\n                print(f\"[Logger] TensorBoard 初始化成功，日志目录：{tb_dir}\")\n                print(f\"         启动命令：tensorboard --logdir {tb_dir}\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"[Logger] TensorBoard 不可用，跳过：{e}\")\n                self._writer = None\n\n        if self._wandb is None and self._writer is None:\n            print(\"[Logger] wandb 与 TensorBoard 均不可用，仅记录 CSV。\")\n\n    def update_config(self, cfg: dict):\n        \"\"\"向 wandb run 写入超参数\"\"\"",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "import numpy as np"
          },

        "contents": "def train(log_dir):\n\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 初始化日志器\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    logger = Logger(\n        log_dir=log_dir,\n        project=\"cable_robot_wbagent\",\n        run_name=os.path.basename(log_dir),\n        use_wandb=True,\n        use_tb=True,\n    )\n    logger.update_config({\n        \"n_episodes\":      n_episodes,\n        \"max_steps_per_ep\": 150,\n        \"state_dim\":       STATE_DIM,\n        \"action_dim\":      ACTION_DIM,\n        \"max_action\":      MAX_ACTION,\n        \"warmup_episodes\": WARMUP_EPISODES,\n        \"explore_noise\":   EXPLORE_NOISE,\n        \"delta\":           agent.delta,\n        \"epsilon_min\":     agent.epsilon_min,\n        \"gamma\":           agent.gamma,\n        \"tau\":             agent.tau,\n        \"batch_size\":      agent.batch_size,\n    })\n\n    # CSV\n    log_file = os.path.join(log_dir, 'log.csv')\n    with open(log_file, \"w\", newline='') as csvfile:\n        writer = csv.writer(csvfile)\n        writer.writerow(['episode', 'frames', 'return', 'Lc', 'La', 'Lbc', 'ratio', 'eps'])\n\n    frames_total = 0\n    loss_c = loss_a = loss_bc = 0.0\n\n    SMOOTH_WIN  = 20\n    reward_hist = []\n    steps_hist  = []\n\n    progress = Progress(\n        \"[progress.description]{task.description}\",\n        BarColumn(),\n        \"[progress.percentage]{task.percentage:\u003e3.1f}%\",\n        TimeElapsedColumn(),\n        TimeRemainingColumn(),\n        auto_refresh=False\n    )\n\n    with progress:\n        task_id =",

        "contents": "if __name__ == '__main__':\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Test Cable Robot Policy')\n    \n    # 恢复原有的所有 mode choices\n    parser.add_argument('--mode', type=str, default='actor_obstacles', \n                        choices=['base', 'actor', 'obstacles', 'obstacles_base', 'actor_obstacles'],\n                        help='Test mode')\n    parser.add_argument('--render', action='store_true', help='Enable MuJoCo rendering')\n    parser.add_argument('--episodes', type=int, default=10, help='Number of test episodes')\n    parser.add_argument('--dir', type=str, default='saves/nmpc_experiment_0.95', help='Directory with actor.pt')\n\n    # 障碍物模式专用参数\n    parser.add_argument('--obstacles', type=int, default=3, help='[obstacles] Number of obstacles per episode')\n    parser.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=42, help='[obstacles] Obstacle RNG seed')\n    parser.add_argument('--save_paths_dir', type=str, default=None,\n                        help='[obstacles] Save planned 3D paths as CSV to this dir')\n    parser.add_argument('--payload_radius', type=float, default=0.10, help='[obstacles] Payload safety radius (m)')\n    parser.add_argument('--planning_margin', type=float, default=0.10, help='[obstacles] Planning margin (m)')\n    parser.add_argument('--planning_grid_res', type=float, default=0.02, help='[obstacles] Grid resolution (m)')\n\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    # 路由及参数传递：基础 2D 环境与 3D 障碍物环境的分流",

        "contents": "def train(log_dir):\n    global nmpc_instance\n\n    # 实例化 3D 环境，包含障碍物\n    env = CableRobotEnvWithObstacles(\n        render=False, \n        n_obstacles=3,\n        latency_steps=1,\n        force_noise_level=0.08,\n        control_freq_hz=10,\n        init_velocity_scale=0.08,\n        init_position_range=0.00,  # 关键：消除初始随机偏移，防止起飞剧烈摇摆\n        obstacle_radius_range=(0.01, 0.02),\n        path_width=0.12,\n        default_start_xy=[0.2, 0.2],\n        default_target_xy=[0.5, 0.5],\n        payload_radius=0.10,       # 关键：增大避障安全距离，防止刮蹭碰撞\n        planning_margin=0.10,      # 关键：增大规划边距\n        planning_grid_res=0.02\n    )\n    nmpc_instance = NMPCTrajectoryTracker()\n\n    MAX_ACTION = 0.5\n    # 维度严格对齐环境的 23 维和控制器的 3 维输出\n    STATE_DIM  = 23   # 10(base) + 9(obs) + 4(z_info)\n    ACTION_DIM = 3    # ax, ay, az\n\n    def env_aware_nmpc_wrapper(state_input):\n        # 核心逻辑：只有在单步交互（非 batch）时，才强制让 NMPC 读取环境同步的路点索引\n        is_batch = len(getattr(state_input, 'shape', [])) \u003e 1\n        current_wp = None if is_batch else getattr(env, 'current_wp_idx', None)\n        return nmpc_wrapper(state_input, env_wp_idx=current_wp)\n\n    agent = WBAgent(\n        log_dir=log_dir,\n        state_dim=STATE_DIM,\n        action_dim=ACTION_DIM,\n        max_action=MAX_ACTION,\n        mixed_q=True,\n        base_boot=True,\n        behavior_clone=True,\n        base_controller_func=env_aware_nmpc_wrapper\n    )\n\n    agent.delta       = 5e-6\n    agent.epsilon_min = 0.1\n\n    WARMUP_EPISODES = 100\n    EXPLORE_NOISE   = 0.05\n    n_episodes      = 4000\n\n    if not os.path.exists(log_dir):\n        os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)\n\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 初始化日志器\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    logger",

        "contents": "class WBAgent:\n\"\"\"\n \n    def __init__(self, log_dir, state_dim, action_dim, max_action=0.5,\n                 mixed_q=True, base_boot=True, behavior_clone=True,\n                 base_controller_func=None):\n \n        self.state_dim  = state_dim\n        self.action_dim = action_dim\n        self.max_action = max_action\n        self.mixed_q    = mixed_q\n        self.base_boot  = base_boot\n        self.behavior_clone = behavior_clone\n        self.base_controller_func = base_controller_func\n \n        # ---------- Actor ----------\n        self.actor        = opt_cuda(FastActor(state_dim, action_dim, max_action))\n        self.target_actor = opt_cuda(FastActor(state_dim, action_dim, max_action))\n        self.target_actor.load_state_dict(self.actor.state_dict())\n        self.optimizer_actor = torch.optim.Adam(self.actor.parameters(), lr=1e-4)\n \n        # ---------- Twin Critic ----------\n        self.critic        = opt_cuda(TwinCritic(state_dim, action_dim))\n        self.target_critic = opt_cuda(TwinCritic(state_dim, action_dim))\n        self.target_critic.load_state_dict(self.critic.state_dict())\n        self.optimizer_critic = torch.optim.Adam(self.critic.parameters(), lr=1e-3)\n \n        # ---------- Epsilon 探索（与原版保持一致）----------\n        self.epsilon     = 1.0\n        self.epsilon_min = 0.1\n        self.delta       = 5e-6\n \n        # ---------- TD3 专属超参数 ----------\n        # Target Policy Smoothing：对目标动作添加截断高斯噪声，\n        #         "contents": "def train_rl(log_dir):\n    # ax, ay, az\n \n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 2. Agent 初始化\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    agent = PureRLAgent(\n        log_dir=log_dir,\n        state_dim=STATE_DIM,\n        action_dim=ACTION_DIM,\n        max_action=MAX_ACTION,\n    )\n \n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 3. 超参数\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    n_episodes   = 20000\n    MAX_EP_STEPS = 150\n \n    # Warmup：前 WARMUP_STEPS 环境步使用均匀随机动作填充 buffer\n    # 不用 episode 数而用 step 数，是因为纯RL早期每局可能很短（频繁 done）\n    WARMUP_STEPS = 15000\n \n    # 高斯探索噪声：σ 从 EXPLORE_NOISE_START 线性退火到 EXPLORE_NOISE_END\n    # 退火总步数 = n_episodes * MAX_EP_STEPS（与 epsilon 退火逻辑对等）\n    EXPLORE_NOISE_START = 0.1   # 初始较大，鼓励广泛探索\n    EXPLORE_NOISE_END   = 0.02  # 最终较小，收敛后精细利用\n    total_train_steps   = n_episodes * MAX_EP_STEPS\n    noise_decay_rate    = (EXPLORE_NOISE_START - EXPLORE_NOISE_END) / total_train_steps\n \n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 4. 日志\n    # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    if not os.path.exists(log_dir):\n        os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)\n \n    logger = Logger(\n        log_dir=log_dir,\n        project=\"cable_robot_pure_rl\",\n        run_name=os.path.basename(log_dir),\n        use_wandb=True,\n        use_tb=True,\n    )\n    logger.update_config({\n        \"mode\":               \"pure_rl\",\n        \"n_episodes\":         n_episodes",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "def run_test_obstacles(mode, log_dir, n_episodes=10, render=False, n_obstacles=3,\n                       obstacle_seed=42, save_paths_dir=None,\n                       payload_radius=0.2, planning_margin=0.2, planning_grid_res=0.02,\n                       default_start_xy=None, default_target_xy=None, device_id=0):\n    \"\"\"带障碍物避碰的 NMPC 测试：CableRobotEnvWithObstacles + NMPCTrajectoryTracker。\"\"\"\n    \n    # 严格保留原有环境参数\n    env = CableRobotEnvWithObstacles(\n        render=render,\n        latency_steps=1,\n        force_noise_level=0.08,\n        control_freq_hz=10,\n        init_velocity_scale=0.08,\n        init_position_range=0.00,\n        n_obstacles=n_obstacles,\n        obstacle_radius_range=(0.01, 0.02),\n        path_width=0.12,\n        obstacle_seed=obstacle_seed,\n        default_start_xy=default_start_xy or [0.2, 0.2],\n        default_target_xy=default_target_xy or [0.5, 0.5],\n        payload_radius=payload_radius,\n        planning_margin=planning_margin,\n        planning_grid_res=planning_grid_res,\n    )\n\n    actor_model = None\n    nmpc_controller = None\n\n    # 模型加载与初始化\n    if mode == 'actor_obstacles':\n        print(f\"Loading Actor model from {log_dir}/actor.pt ...\")\n        device = get_device(device_id)\n        model_path = os.path.join(log_dir, 'actor.pt')\n        if not os.path.exists(model_path):\n            print(f\"Error: Model not found at {model_path}\")\n            return\n        \n        try:\n            actor_model = torch.load(model_path, map_location=device, weights_only=False)\n        except TypeError:\n            actor_model = torch.load(model_path, map_location=device)\n        actor_model.eval()\n        \n    elif mode in ['obstacles', 'obstacles_base']:\n        print(\"Initializing NMPC Trajectory Tracker (Following 3D path)...\")\n        nmpc_controller = NMPCTrajectoryTracker()\n\n    if save_paths_dir is not None:\n        os.makedirs(save_paths_dir, exist_ok=True)",

            "lineNumber": 132,
            "text": "        obstacle_seed=obstacle_seed,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 133,
            "text": "        default_start_xy=default_start_xy or [0.2, 0.2],"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 134,
            "text": "        default_target_xy=default_target_xy or [0.5, 0.5],"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 135,
            "text": "        payload_radius=payload_radius,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136,
            "text": "        planning_margin=planning_margin,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 137,
            "text": "        planning_grid_res=planning_grid_res,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138,
            "text": "    )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140,
            "text": "    actor_model = None"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141,
            "text": "    nmpc_controller = None"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143,
            "text": "    # 模型加载与初始化"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 144,
            "text": "    if mode == 'actor_obstacles':"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145,
            "text": "        print(f\"Loading Actor model from {log_dir}/actor.pt ...\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 146,
            "text": "        device = get_device(device_id)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147,
            "text": "        model_path = os.path.join(log_dir, 'actor.pt')"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 148,
            "text": "        if not os.path.exists(model_path):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149,
            "text": "            print(f\"Error: Model not found at {model_path}\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150,
            "text": "            return"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 151,
            "text": "        "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152,
            "text": "        try:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153,
            "text": "            actor_model = torch.load(model_path, map_location=device, weights_only=False)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154,
            "text": "        except TypeError:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 155,
            "text": "            actor_model = torch.load(model_path, map_location=device)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156,
            "text": "        actor_model.eval()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157,
            "text": "        "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158,
            "text": "    elif mode in ['obstacles', 'obstacles_base']:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159,
            "text": "        print(\"Initializing NMPC Trajectory Tracker (Following 3D path)...\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160,
            "text": "        nmpc_controller = NMPCTrajectoryTracker()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162,
            "text": "    if save_paths_dir is not None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 163,
            "text": "        os.makedirs(save_paths_dir, exist_ok=True)"
          }
        ],

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# 基于基座控制器的长时域稀疏奖励机械臂任务学习\n\n本文档为项目 **BCLearning_with_nmpc** 的详细中文说明，涵盖每个代码文件的功能与主要实现逻辑。\n\n---\n\n## 一、项目概述\n\n本项目实现论文 **\"Learning of Long-Horizon Sparse-Reward Robotic Manipulator Tasks with Base Controllers\"**（TNNLS）中的方法，核心思想是：\n\n- **基座控制器（Base Controller）**：使用 NMPC（非线性模型预测控制）作为“老师”，在稀疏奖励、长时域任务中提供稳定的基础策略。\n- **强化学习智能体（DDPG + 行为克隆）**：在模仿 NMPC 的基础上，通过 Q 值引导探索，学习超越基座控制器的策略。\n\n当前代码已从 **PyBullet + Kuka 机械臂** 迁移到 **MuJoCo + 缆索机器人（Cable Robot）** 环境，并增加了延迟、外力扰动、随机初始化等 Sim2Real 相关设置。\n\n### 论文信息\n\n- **标题**：Learning of Long-Horizon Sparse-Reward Robotic Manipulator Tasks with Base Controllers  \n- **作者**：Guangming Wang, Minjian Xin, Wenhua Wu, Zhe Liu, Hesheng Wang  \n- **期刊**：IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS), 2022  \n\n---\n\n## 二、项目目录结构\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nBCLearning_with_nmpc/\n├── agent.py              # 智能体：Actor/Critic 网络、经验回放、WBAgent 逻辑\n├── kuka.py               # PyBullet 版 Kuka 机械臂与环境（原论文实现，当前未用）\n├── learn.py              # 训练入口：环境创建、NMPC 封装、训练循环、评估与保存\n├── mujoco_env.py         # MuJoCo 缆索机器人环境（含 CableRobotEnvWithObstacles 与 2D 路径规划）\n├── nmpc_controller.py    # NMPC 基座控制器（含 NMPCControllerObstacles 避障版）\n├── plot.py               # 读取 log.csv，绘制训练曲线（成功率、Base 使用比例等）\n├── test.py               # 测试脚本：Actor / NMPC base / NMPC+障碍物 三种模式\n├── IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md # 实现与参数修改说明（英文）",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "# 基于基座控制器的长时域稀疏奖励机械臂任务学习"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "本文档为项目 **BCLearning_with_nmpc** 的详细中文说明，涵盖每个代码文件的功能与主要实现逻辑。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "## 一、项目概述"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "本项目实现论文 **\"Learning of Long-Horizon Sparse-Reward Robotic Manipulator Tasks with Base Controllers\"**（TNNLS）中的方法，核心思想是："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11,
            "text": "- **基座控制器（Base Controller）**：使用 NMPC（非线性模型预测控制）作为“老师”，在稀疏奖励、长时域任务中提供稳定的基础策略。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "- **强化学习智能体（DDPG + 行为克隆）**：在模仿 NMPC 的基础上，通过 Q 值引导探索，学习超越基座控制器的策略。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "当前代码已从 **PyBullet + Kuka 机械臂** 迁移到 **MuJoCo + 缆索机器人（Cable Robot）** 环境，并增加了延迟、外力扰动、随机初始化等 Sim2Real 相关设置。"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "### 论文信息"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "- **标题**：Learning of Long-Horizon Sparse-Reward Robotic Manipulator Tasks with Base Controllers  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "- **作者**：Guangming Wang, Minjian Xin, Wenhua Wu, Zhe Liu, Hesheng Wang  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "- **期刊**：IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS), 2022  "
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "---"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "## 二、项目目录结构"
          },

            "lineNumber": 25

          {
            "lineNumber": 26,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;"

          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "BCLearning_with_nmpc/"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "├── agent.py              # 智能体：Actor/Critic 网络、经验回放、WBAgent 逻辑"
          },
          {

            "text": "├── kuka.py               # PyBullet 版 Kuka 机械臂与环境（原论文实现，当前未用）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "├── learn.py              # 训练入口：环境创建、NMPC 封装、训练循环、评估与保存"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "├── mujoco_env.py         # MuJoCo 缆索机器人环境（含 CableRobotEnvWithObstacles 与 2D 路径规划）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "├── nmpc_controller.py    # NMPC 基座控制器（含 NMPCControllerObstacles 避障版）"

            "lineNumber": 33,
